title: Interpretability, Alignment, Safety, and Security in Machine Learning
description:
This video explains the four distinct pillars of the toolkit for controlling frontier machine learning models: interpretability, alignment, safety, and security. It discusses the challenges of ensuring that AI systems do exactly what we want and nothing we don't, and how these pillars work together to provide a comprehensive approach to AI assurance. The video also covers the importance of understanding the sociotechnical system, including the model, data, tools, permissions, users, organization, infrastructure, and governance, and how this understanding can help us build more trustworthy AI systems.
